Patient: 'I coughed up a bit of blood on, on two occasions.' This describes hemoptysis twice.
Patient: 'I've had a , I've got a bit of slight fever' indicates subjective fever.
Patient: 'I can sort of feel my heart beating... I can just sort of feel it, more' and doctor later says 'you're feeling your heart racing.' This supports sensation of heart 'pounding.'

Onset today: Doctor: 'And how long has this been going on for now?' Patient: 'Just, just today really.' Doctor: 'the last day or so that's when you get the cough and the pain in the side? And you've cough blood, OK.'

Patient: 'yeah performing, , performing daily activities has, has been a bit harder than usual.'

Patient: 'I work in an office, just a, desk job.' and 'Do you live alone? Patient: 'Uh, yes.' 'In a flat or a house?' Patient: 'Flat.' 'Do you have any pets?' Patient: 'Cat.'
